name: ai4kanban-desktop
description: The AI4Kanban board as a desktop app — no terminal, no Node, nothing to install first.
author: AI4Kanban contributors

scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/bundle-ui.mjs --if-missing && node scripts/bundle-cli.mjs && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac --win --linux
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run bundle && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run bundle && electron-builder --linux
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && node --check scripts/after-pack.js && node --check scripts/bundle-cli.mjs && node --check scripts/bundle-ui.mjs
